CommandK is in the (app) layout, but on /no-access useAccount resolves to the user's last or first account (EmailAccountProvider.tsx:79-105), so the href is /{id}/bulk-unsubscribe. Even with an empty id, /bulk-unsubscribe is a redirect-only page that sends the user to /{id}/bulk-unsubscribe or /connect-mailbox (app/(redirects)/bulk-unsubscribe/page.tsx; utils/account.ts:56-79).

Items fall back to href "/status-pages" when the workspace has more than one page (nav-banner-checklist.tsx:51-53), and status-pages/(list)/page.tsx exists.

Header is rendered unconditionally in root app/layout.tsx:143; header.tsx:758 is the Integrations preview Link in the desktop Resources dropdown, and app/integrations/page.tsx exists.

The generator is mounted in (commonLayout)/global-mounts.tsx, so the source holds. /access-point needs the creator's freshly created app to return permission_keys with no layout, monitor, log or config permission (utils/app-redirection.ts:21-34), and the keys come from backend RBAC (api/controllers/console/app/permission_keys.py). The creator normally lands on /workflow.

SettingsDialog, mounted in the (app) layout (layout.tsx:118), renders SettingsContent with a Beta Features link to /early-access (SettingsContent.tsx:186). That route has a page at app/(app)/early-access/page.tsx.
